Learning to Cook Fried Rice: 第一次下厨学做蛋炒饭:打碎鸡蛋、被溅起的油吓到,但二十分钟后全家都夸好吃。

Last month, I decided to learn to cook. My first dish was egg fried rice, because my mother said it was the easiest one to start with. She wrote the steps on a piece of paper and stood beside me in the kitchen.
Things did not go well at first. I broke an egg on the floor, and the oil jumped out of the pan when it got hot. I almost wanted to give up, but Mum just laughed and told me to slow down.

Twenty minutes later, the fried rice was finally ready. It looked a little messy, but it smelled wonderful. My father tried it and said it was better than the fried rice in the restaurant near our home. Now I cook dinner every Friday, and I enjoy it a lot.
